name: agentlenspro-review-mod
description: The harness runs the adversarial REVIEW (and, for a proposal, the MEASUREMENT) of every turn, via $.model.fork, and blocks the stop on BLOCKERS; interrupted turns are reviewed too. Janitor turns and agent-message turns that changed nothing are exempt. The model spawns nothing. Reports and usage are shown to the user only, in colour, by a Stop command hook (needs python3). Needs the agentlenspro CLI with work/proposal in review-gate --json-verdict.
